answer.says: You are right. The particular must be consumed before it becomes a stain on the universal surface.
answer.thought: The samosa is a fragile vessel of truth, hot and precarious. I will not let the oil defeat the structure; I will eat it with the precision of a man who knows that digestion is the first step of philosophy.
